Parties.span: This Master Services Agreement is entered into between Acme Corporation and Globex Limited.

Termination for Convenience.span: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days prior written notice to the other party.

Payment Terms.span: The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt.

Limitation of Liability.span: The aggregate liability of either party shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim.

Governing Law.span: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.

Confidentiality.span: Each party shall keep the Confidential Information of the other party in confidence for five years following disclosure.
